report:
Reviewed meta.reviews.summary_format against its complete current claim, sole ordinary implementation association in crates/sage-meta/src/review.rs, and both ordinary associated tests; no TODO/N/A entries exist. Additional captured context includes Fixture setup/read/write/approval helpers, the fragment_freshness claim, a focused stale-input test, and the shared check integration. No historical verdict is used as a substitute for inspection.

All five summary fields are present in the serde Summary struct with deny_unknown_fields. start validates and resolves the full anchor ID, writes that ID, assigns started_at_unix_seconds from now(), initializes recorded_at_unix_seconds to None (serialized null), and assigns the schema and policy constants. now() uses SystemTime duration_since UNIX_EPOCH and as_secs(), establishing seconds rather than milliseconds or a monotonic clock. record loads and preserves this summary, validates inputs, writes the report, then assigns Some(now()) and persists the recording time. read_summary rejects an identity differing from the directory and versions differing from current constants. The entire essential summary implementation is in the initially captured and associated review.rs; the shared check is captured as supporting call-site context, not a second implementation of summary serialization.

start_invalidates_previous_success_and_record_is_required explicitly asserts the dotted anchor demo.rule, a positive unsigned start timestamp, null recording timestamp before recording, and exact schema/policy constant values. After record it asserts an unsigned recording timestamp at least the start time; it also verifies absence of an obsolete input_sha256 field and preserved input bytes. Its gate assertions show an unfinished summary remains unapproved and a completed current record is accepted. unsupported_versions_and_mismatched_identity_cannot_pass independently mutates schema_version, policy_version and anchor, and requires an error identifying the anchor and the precise unsupported-version or mismatch reason. Fixture uses real temporary Cargo/model/source files and JSON reads; the assertions are in the test bodies rather than hidden in setup helpers. These checks would detect omitted/wrong fields, a nonnull initial record time, an absent completed timestamp, or ignored version/identity changes. Exact epoch units are established by the inspected standard-library calculation; the tests establish timestamp type, initialization and lifecycle ordering.

The closing freshness qualification is accounted for by input_errors: current initial fragments are compared exactly with the saved prefix, associations are checked separately, and additional selected source is compared by exact string equality with joined saved contents. record rejects resulting errors; validate/acceptable use the same path, while summary time is not a source-freshness substitute. Captured supplemental invalid_reports_and_stale_inputs_never_complete_an_active_review changes implementation source after start, asserts record rejection, unchanged captured bytes and a failing shared check. This supports the freshness cross-reference without expanding this summary-format review into a separate review of every selector contract. The shared check invokes inventory, load_saved and validate and rejects diagnostics. No contradictory behavior or test inadequacy was found for this anchor.

Execution distinction: I executed review start and review read commands, inspected their current captured source, and submit this report through review record. I did not rerun suites or build. The coordinator separately reports 331 functional tests, 31 review tests and a successful cargo build; that execution is reported evidence, not execution performed by this reviewer. No Rust or specification source was edited.
